story.title: The Rogue Heartbeat
story.logline: A teenager who suddenly loses her pulse discovers a glowing countdown under her skin that reveals a dangerous secret about her true identity.
story.twist: She isn't a malfunctioning robot being hunted; she is a human mind trapped inside a synth body designed to protect her real body hiding elsewhere.
story.ending: Her synthetic body shuts down, awakening her human self in the real world.

scenes.narration: My heart stopped beating three days ago, yet here I am, standing on a freezing train platform totally alive.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Maya, a 17-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail, wearing an oversized faded yellow hoodie and black cargo pants, stands motionless on a misty, abandoned train platform under flickering neon lights at midnight, clutching her chest with wide, terrified eyes.
scenes.camera: Medium eye-level shot holding static focus on Maya.

scenes.narration: Nobody notices the silence inside my chest, but everyone keeps looking at my wrist as if it's bleeding.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Maya, a 17-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail, wearing an oversized faded yellow hoodie and black cargo pants, walks past blurry shadowy commuters on a misty, abandoned train platform under flickering neon lights at midnight while staring down at her glowing right wrist.
scenes.camera: Slow tracking shot following her as she walks.

scenes.narration: I finally look down and see a faint digital counter glowing red beneath my skin, rapidly ticking toward zero.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Close-up of Maya, a 17-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail, wearing an oversized faded yellow hoodie and black cargo pants, on a misty, abandoned train platform under flickering neon lights at midnight, as a bright red digital countdown timer glows faintly beneath the skin of her forearm.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up macro shot on her forearm.

scenes.narration: Panic sets in when a tall conductor grabs my shoulder, shouting that un-synced citizens must report for immediate disposal.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. A sinister train conductor in a dark uniform grabs the shoulder of Maya, a 17-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail, wearing an oversized faded yellow hoodie and black cargo pants, on a misty, abandoned train platform under flickering neon lights at midnight.
scenes.camera: Low-angle whip pan up to the conductor's face.

scenes.narration: I break free and sprint down the foggy platform, cold air burning in lungs that do not actually need oxygen.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Action shot of Maya, a 17-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail, wearing an oversized faded yellow hoodie and black cargo pants, sprinting desperately away down a misty, abandoned train platform under flickering neon lights at midnight.
scenes.camera: Handheld dynamic tracking shot following her run.

scenes.narration: Hiding inside an empty train car, I slice open my glowing wrist with a sharp key to stop the countdown.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Maya, a 17-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail, wearing an oversized faded yellow hoodie and black cargo pants, crouches inside a dark train car parked at a misty, abandoned train platform under flickering neon lights at midnight, holding a sharp bronze key against her arm.
scenes.camera: High-angle shot looking down at her crouching figure.

scenes.narration: Instead of blood, copper wires and blue liquid pour out, revealing metallic gears spinning where my veins should be.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Close-up on the arm of Maya, a 17-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail, wearing an oversized faded yellow hoodie and black cargo pants, inside a dark train car at a misty, abandoned train platform under flickering neon lights at midnight, revealing copper wires and glowing blue synthetic fluid beneath her skin.
scenes.camera: Tight macro insert shot focusing on the wound.

scenes.narration: A recorded human voice suddenly echoes from my inner speaker—my own real voice from a life I completely forgot.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Maya, a 17-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail, wearing an oversized faded yellow hoodie and black cargo pants, stares in utter shock inside a dark train car at a misty, abandoned train platform under flickering neon lights at midnight as blue light projects from her chest.
scenes.camera: Slow push-in zoom on her stunned face.

scenes.narration: I was never a malfunctioned machine; I was a human mind uploaded to hide from the city's mandatory memory purge.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Dramatic close-up of Maya, a 17-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail, wearing an oversized faded yellow hoodie and black cargo pants, inside a dark train car at a misty, abandoned train platform under flickering neon lights at midnight, her face illuminated by holographic memories of her human past.
scenes.camera: Medium close-up swirling 360-degree rotation around her.

scenes.narration: The timer hits zero, my fake body freezes, and I realize my real heart never stopped beating at all.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot. Maya, a 17-year-old girl with a messy brown ponytail, wearing an oversized faded yellow hoodie and black cargo pants, stands frozen like a statue on a misty, abandoned train platform under flickering neon lights at midnight, as her eyes glow softly in the dark.
scenes.camera: Slow pull-back wide shot fading out into silence.

caption.hook: No pulse. Just a glowing countdown.
caption.title: The Rogue Heartbeat
caption.caption:
She thought she was a broken machine running out of time. But when the chest plate finally cracks, the truth is far more terrifying: she is the armor, not the human. Where is the real her?

Would you trade your humanity to survive?
